Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that Monster A Go-Go’s “officially credited” director was Bill Rebane (born 1937) while instructing to ignore uncredited contributors. In reality, Herschell Gordon Lewis (born 1926) is credited on releases, making Monster A Go-Go’s director older than Pasquale Festa Campanile (1927) of The Gamecock. This misidentification contradicts the Planner’s own rule about using credited directors and would lead to the wrong comparative conclusion.
